html:
AI is an intelligent tool. And any tool is as great as the human using it.

At Osman Academy, we teach humans the knowledge and wisdom to build production-grade AI systems that align with human interests to make this world a more peaceful and prosperous place to live for everyone.

Discover Our Teaching Philosophy
How we teach

Our Teaching Philosophy

We believe the most effective way to learn AI is to own the learning process: stay curious, do the thinking yourself, and never let AI think for you. As you learn, ask yourself one question: could I teach what I just learned to my family or friends? If yes, move on. If not, keep working until you can. To help you get there, we built our curriculum on two foundations, Knowledge and Wisdom, taught through a 4-step cognitive process. Knowledge comes from the coursework: lessons, guides, and practice. Wisdom comes from the doing: role-play, assignments, and projects.

01
Knowledge

Learn

Watch the lesson, then clarify the concept with reading and visual guides until the idea is solid.

02
Knowledge

Practice

Check what you recall, then rehearse the skill in a guided, low-risk setting with real feedback.

03
Wisdom

Apply

Put judgment to the test in role-play scenarios and realistic assignments — the kind of decisions you'd actually face outside the course.

04
Wisdom

Master

Prove it through a capstone project that puts everything you've learned, knowledge and wisdom both, to work.

Discover the Team who follow this philosophy
Get to know us

Same family, three fields, one goal: getting you AI-fluent.

Discover what we teach & what you will get
What we teach & what you will get

Practical AI Skills Program

Beginners face AI uncertainty: too much information, no clear place to start. This program gives you four ordered learning programs, from AI Fundamentals to AI Architecture, each one written from scratch by people who've actually built production AI systems. By the end, you can design and build a complete AI system yourself.

4 Learning Programs, Beginner to Advanced

Start with AI Fundamentals and move up through Associate, Developer, and Architect — each one builds on the last, so you always know your next step.

A Portfolio Employers Notice

You'll leave with 6–15 real projects, each polished with our help, so your portfolio does the talking in interviews.

The Skills That Actually Get You Hired

Live sessions with working tech professionals cover the soft skills — communication, framing your work, interviewing — that separate 'knows AI' from 'gets hired'.

A Community That Has Your Back

Stuck on something? Our discussion forums are full of professionals ready to help. You're never doing this alone.

Fair questions

Frequently asked questions

Who should join these programs?

[Draft] Anyone who wants to build real, usable AI skills — whether you're starting from zero or already using AI at work and want to do it properly. The four paths cover different starting points.

Do I need a technical background?

[Draft] Not for AI Fundamentals or AI Associate — no coding required. AI Developer and AI Architect assume progressively more technical experience.

What will I be able to do afterwards?

[Draft] Structure an AI task properly, judge whether the output holds up, and apply it to real work. Each course ends with a portfolio capstone — a real artifact you can show.

How are the courses delivered?

[Draft] Recorded video courses hosted on Udemy, taken at your own pace. Where useful, live group sessions run in local communities: watch the course together, then open discussion.

What do the courses cost?

[Draft] Pricing is being finalized. AI Fundamentals opens first — the other three paths are marked "Coming soon" until they're ready.

Do I get a certificate?

[Draft] Not from Osman Academy — Udemy tracks course completion. What you take away is the capstone artifact and the skills themselves.

When will the courses be available?

[Draft] AI Associate publishes first, with the others following in sequence. Each is built and tested before release rather than rushed out.

Who teaches these courses?

[Draft] Osman Academy is a family initiative. Osman Mohammed (12+ years software engineering, Big 4 consulting delivery) builds and teaches the technical material; Abdul Bari Mohammed (15+ years business process development) and Firdous Osman (instructional designer, ex-high school teacher and department head) shape how it's applied and how it's taught. Every lesson is written from scratch.

What if the course isn't right for me?

[Draft — verify against Udemy's current refund policy before publishing] Purchases are handled by Udemy and covered by their refund policy.
